author: Polar_Express
body:
Folks - What Kind of map would you like to see in the walls? I am about to start making another map as my last and only 4 have finally been completed and will be in rotation before long if the gameplay is ok after testing... So I want the community to give me some ideas ( if anyone has time) on the kind of maps that would make you want to play walls, make it fun for you, and exciting! A. Esthetics / Theme: What should it look like / where should the battles take place? (The scene)   B. Resources: Anything special you want to see in the map? (More TNT? More strength potions, more diamonds, more named/epic weapons and armor? etc.?)   C. Game play thoughts:  What aspects of game play would you like to see? Maybe you want to be able to see all of the map form a vantage point? Maybe you want the resources to be 20 blocks deep and not much caves and mining, or on the other hand you want to see more caves and mining? Maybe you think we need a map with more woods?   D. How do you like to play walls? Do you wait underground surrounded by lava? Do you like to sky base? Are you a 100% team player and only go to battle when you have friends? Are you an invisibility player? (Only attack when you have invisibility) etc. - Tell me how you play,  it will help in building.   Also - What makes you log off:  
  1. You quit when: You can’t find resources (mining fail log)?
  2. You quit when: Others take all the stuff first (chest fail log)?
  3. You quit when: You don’t have team mates to play with (team fail log)?
  4. You quit when: Hackers ruin the game (hacking log)?
  5. You quit when: You are harassed by a team killer (team killer log)?
  6. You stop playing because maps are old (old /no fun maps)?
  7. Walls game play is boring (rarely play)?
  Give as much or as little as you like – but any information will help. Thanks again!

replies.author: Numberz_
replies.body:
I would like to see some maps with underground walls if that is possible.
  1. You quit when: You can’t find resources (mining fail log)? I never quit if that happens.
  2. You quit when: Others take all the stuff first (chest fail log)? I will quit when I don't get some chests.
  3. You quit when: You don’t have team mates to play with (team fail log)? Nope I like to play solo.
  4. You quit when: Hackers ruin the game (hacking log)? I have never seen a hacker in walls yet.
  5. You quit when: You are harassed by a team killer (team killer log)? I will try to record them if they have a lava bucket.
  6. You stop playing because maps are old (old /no fun maps)? I enjoy playing the older maps more then the newer ones but all the maps are fun.
  7. Walls game play is boring (rarely play)? I always enjoy walls games they don't get boring.

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
A. Esthetics - I like maps with the most variety of game play which are pleasant to view.  The unique looks of both Oz and Wild West are original, but I also like the classic look of Village and Garden as well.

B. I like the maps with specialty or "legendary" items.  It's fun to see how many you can acquire during the match.  Also, I'd like to see more traps and secret buttons that do things.  On another server, I liked this feature where you stand under a dispenser (triggered by a pressure plate) that splashes potions on you.

C. Game play - Some maps I don't like to skybase on because lack of resources to build up and make a cool base or there is no space (too cluttered). I want to be able to rush or skybase depending on how I feel or who I'm teamed with.

D. How do you like to play walls - Team player all the way.  I like to share or trade items with teammates and stick together during game play.

E. What makes you log off - Nothing.  I play way too much. :P
